column6: I am using the Groww app for mutual fund investments, and overall experience is good, but ….
column7: 1) Mandate (AutoPay) Limits  Currently, AutoPay mandate is quite restrictive:  - UPI mandate is limited (generally up to ₹1–2 lakh depending on bank)  - Net banking mandate allows only up to around ₹5 lakh  - Default practical usage often stays near ₹1 lakh for seamless transactions  Because of this, it becomes very difficult for serious investors to invest large lump sum amounts.For example:  - If I want to invest ₹10 lakh or more in one go during market correction, it is not possible smoothly using mandate  - I have to split transactions or use manual payment, which defeats the purpose of AutoPay  Other platforms like NJ Wealth provide higher mandate flexibility (₹20–50 lakh or more), which is much more practical for high-value investors.👉 Request:  Please introduce higher mandate limits (₹20–50 lakh or customizable based on user profile and bank approval), especially via net banking/eMandate.---2) Limited SIP Frequency Options  Currently, SIP options are limited to monthly (and some dates).  👉 Missing features:  - Daily SIP option  - Weekly SIP option  These are very useful for:  - Better cost averaging  - Investing during volatile markets  - More flexible cash flow management  Many investors prefer daily/weekly SIP to capture market movements more effectively.---✅ Overall:  Groww is a very user-friendly and excellent platform, but these limitations make it less suitable for high-value and advanced investors.Improving mandate limits and adding flexible SIP frequencies will significantly enhance the platform experience.
